deep.reconstruction:
The page sets up a presentation-style description of a small category A whose objects are the standard finite sets [1,n], n>=1, with morphisms generated by three kinds of maps.

- **Generators.** The inclusion ∂_n:[1,n]→[1,n+1]; the retraction k_n:[1,n+1]→[1,n], which sends n+1 to n (this is forced by k_n σ_{n+1}=k_n, where σ_{n+1} is the transposition (n,n+1)); and the symmetric groups S_n acting on [1,n], with i_n:S_n→S_{n+1} the standard embedding.
- **Relations.**
  - k_n∂_n = id.
  - ∂_nσ = i_n(σ)∂_n.
  - σk_n = k_n i'_n(σ) for σ∈S_{n-1}, where i'_n=i_n i_{n-1}.
  - k_nσ_{n+1} = k_n.
  - The idempotent ∂_n k_n = p_{n+1} is named: the retraction of [1,n+1] onto [1,n].
  - These are, essentially, relations holding in the category of nonempty finite sets [1,n] with all maps (presumably the target category).
- **Dualising.** E_n^* denotes the contravariant data: a presheaf on A, i.e. a 'réalisation dans (Ens)'. It consists of S_n-sets E_n^* with face maps p_n=∂_n^*:E_{n+1}^*→E_n^* and degeneracies d_n=k_n^*:E_n^*→E_{n+1}^*, satisfying the dual relations (*). This is, in modern terms, a symmetric simplicial set (presheaf on finite nonempty sets), presented by generators and relations.
- **Extra axiom (**).** For p,q>=1 the map E_{p+q}^*→E_p^*×E_q^* is surjective. Its components are:
  - α^* = restriction along the inclusion of the first p points, α^*_{n,p}=∂_p^*…∂_{n-1}^*;
  - β^* = restriction along the inclusion of the last q points, β_{n,q}(i)=i+n−q.
  - β^* is written via shifted faces ∂'_m = ρ∂_m, with ρ the cyclic permutation i↦i+1, m+1↦1. Hence ∂'^*_m=∂^*_m ρ^*, with ρ^*=ρ^{-1} for the action convention.
- **Meaning of (**).** It is a joint-extension / 'amalgamation over the empty set' condition. Any two configurations on disjoint finite sets can be realised together. For E_n^*=X^n with X a set it holds with bijection.
- **Purpose.** The next page computes φ_!(F×G) as a colimit over A/F×A/G for a functor φ:A→X into a topos, together with the adjunction φ_!⊣φ^*. So the purpose seems to be studying when the realisation φ_! from presheaves on this category of finite sets preserves products. Condition (**) is presumably a sufficient condition for that, or for some exactness, in the 'topos stratifié' project.
errors: Index inconsistency at the bottom of the page: 'ρ_m ∈ S_{m+1}' is written with ρ_m(i)=i+1 for i∈[1,m] and ρ_m(m+1)=1. Yet ∂'_m=ρ_{m+1}∂_m, and the box uses ρ_{m+1}. The circular permutation should consistently live in S_{m+1}.
The (**) condition is only stated, not motivated or proved on this page.

ideas.what: Presheaves on nonempty finite sets ('symmetric simplicial sets'), presented by faces, degeneracies and symmetric-group actions
ideas.modern_name: symmetric simplicial sets / presheaves on FinSet_{≥1}
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; studied by Grandis, Rosický and others
ideas.where_published: Pursuing Stacks discusses the category of nonempty finite sets as a test category

ideas.what: Surjectivity of E_{p+q}→E_p×E_q (restriction to disjoint first/last blocks)
ideas.modern_name: joint embedding / amalgamation condition (cf. Fraïssé theory, FI-modules)

ideas.what: Describing the 'last q points' inclusion via cyclic-shifted faces ∂'=ρ∂

missed.claim: An axiom (**) of joint extension over disjoint blocks is imposed on symmetric simplicial sets. In context (next page) this seems linked to product preservation of the realisation φ_! from presheaves on finite sets into a topos. The purpose and consequences are not developed here.
missed.quote: E_{p+q}^* → E_p^* × E_q^* surjectif pour p,q ≥ 1
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only mildly. It resembles amalgamation conditions in categorical model theory (Fraïssé, classifying toposes of theories of sets with structure), but too little is on the page to claim a new result.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a standard combinatorial setup of presheaves on finite sets with faces and degeneracies. The joint-extension axiom (**) is the only non-routine element, and its role is unclear from this page.
transcription_corrections: In the dual diagram the lower arrow is labelled 'd_n = k_n^*', not '∂_n = k_n^*'.
Relation (*) for k_n^*: '(id)' is likely 'σ ∈ S_{n-1}' or '(id.)' (idem); the margin reads '(σ∈S_n)' and '(i'σ)'.
The phrase reads 'réalisation dans (Ens) de syst. des (E_n^*, ∂_n^*, k_n^*) satisfaisant [à] … S_n-ens.' — the E_n^* are S_n-sets.
'ρ^*_{m+1} = ρ^{-1}_{m+1} la permutation circulaire st-[?] inv[?] de S_{m+1}' probably reads 'la permutation circulaire standard inverse de S_{m+1}'.
Top: the retraction is written 'K_n'/'k_n' consistently; the arrow label under the first diagram is k_n.
